issue.title: Codex small tier maps to codex-mini-latest, which codex-cli 0.162.1 rejects with HTTP 400 on ChatGPT-account auth

task_type_fields.impact: Any SASE path that resolves the Codex `small` tier (no explicit model or size alias) fails with HTTP 400 on ChatGPT-account hosts.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by sase-1ko.8 (note #3) during the E3 Codex acceptance probes.

`src/sase/llm_provider/models.yml` maps the Codex `small` tier to `codex-mini-latest`
(`codex.tiers.small`). Codex CLI 0.162.1 on this host authenticates with a ChatGPT
account and rejects `codex-mini-latest` with HTTP 400, so every small-tier Codex
invocation (`CodexProvider.resolve_model_name("small")` -> `provider_tier_model("codex", "small")`)
fails before the first turn. The sase-1ko.8 phase had to switch its harness probes to
`gpt-6-luna`, which succeeded in both flag states; the sase-1ko.10 acceptance record also
lists `gpt-6-luna` as the cheapest working Codex model. The size aliases in
`default_config.yml` / `models.yml` already route `@xsmall`/`@small`/`@medium` Codex
work to `gpt-6-luna`, so only the legacy `small` tier is stale.

Repro: `codex exec --model codex-mini-latest ...` under ChatGPT-account auth on
codex-cli 0.162.1 returns HTTP 400; `--model gpt-6-luna` succeeds.
Fix: point `codex.tiers.small` at a model the ChatGPT-account CLI accepts (likely
`gpt-6-luna`), and update any test pinning the old tier value.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by E3 phase sase-1ko.8: its acceptance probes could not use the Codex small-tier model and fell back to gpt-6-luna; the tier mapping is stale and not caused by E3.
